data.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 62

traits.name: Detaching
traits.text: The stirge spends 5 feet of movement to detach, doing so after draining 10 HP or if the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can use an action to detach it. Source continues on p. 63.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.note: On a hit it attaches. While attached it stops attacking; at the start of each stirge turn its target loses 1d4+3 HP. Track the attached target and blood drained.

actions.name: Attached blood loss
actions.range: Start of the attached stirge’s turn
actions.note: No attack roll; this is HP loss, not a fresh piercing hit. Apply manually after checking attachment.

data.name: Stirge
data.variants: Area 3: ten on the 30-foot ceiling. Roll their Stealth once and compare with each unaware character’s passive Perception; do not automatically surprise anyone who is watching the ceiling.

data.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 58

actions.name: Claws
actions.note: A hit on a creature other than an elf or undead also requires DC 10 Constitution save or paralysis for 1 minute. Repeat at the end of each target turn; success ends it.

data.name: Ghoul
data.variants: One bite OR one claw attack, not multiattack. Three begin in area 6 and seven in area 9. Once a claw paralyzes a character, surface the repeat save and close-range critical-hit risk.

data.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 63
data.languages: Understands languages known in life but cannot speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: When damage reduces it to 0 HP, make a Constitution save (+3) against DC 5 + damage taken. Success leaves it at 1 HP. No save if the damage was radiant or came from a critical hit.

data.name: Wave Echo Zombie
data.variants: Area 12: eight dwarven corpses rise when living creatures enter. They pursue beyond this room for no more than one round; track surviving tokens instead of replenishing them.

data.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 57

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: As an action, switch between dim light for 15 feet and bright light for 15 feet plus dim light for another 15 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: If destroyed, regains all HP after 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on the remains or dispel magic or remove curse is cast on them. Record destruction time and treatment; do not silently respawn it when a map opens.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: 5th-level caster; Intelligence, spell DC 13, spell attack +5. Needs verbal components only. Three 1st-level slots, two 2nd-level slots, one 3rd-level slot. Maintain one concentration spell at a time. Source continues on p. 58.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Fire Ray attacks. Casting a spell uses its action instead.

actions.name: Fireball · save damage
actions.note: Spend the sole 3rd-level slot. DC 13 Dexterity save, half on success. Review all creatures and cover in the blast; no attack roll. Spell summary: PHB 2014 p. 241.

actions.name: Magic Missile · one dart
actions.note: Three darts using a 1st-level slot; assign every dart before damage. One extra dart per slot level above 1st. Shield blocks them. PHB 2014 p. 257.

actions.name: Flaming Sphere · save damage
actions.note: Spend a 2nd-level slot; concentration up to 1 minute. DC 13 Dexterity save, half, when the sphere is rammed into a creature or a creature ends its turn within 5 feet. Move up to 30 feet with bonus action; do not damage simply for entering its radius. PHB 2014 p. 242.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.text: Spend a 1st-level slot when hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile: +5 AC until start of next turn, including the triggering attack, and no magic missile damage. One reaction.

spells: 2nd level (2 slots): blur, flaming sphere. Blur uses an action, concentration up to 1 minute; sight-based attacks against it have disadvantage unless the attacker has an appropriate bypass.
data.name: Flameskull
data.variants: Area 12 is a dangerous spell encounter, especially for level-3 characters. Describe the green skull before triggering a fight; support withdrawal through the channel. Fireball can be fatal. Track destroyed time, prevention of rejuvenation, remaining slots, and zombies individually.

data.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

traits.name: Mage Armor
traits.text: Base AC 11; AC 14 while mage armor is active. Cast using a 1st-level slot, lasts 8 hours, no concentration. Set AC to 14 only after recording the cast and spending the slot.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic cannot put him to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: Disadvantage on attacks while either he or his target is in sunlight.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: No material components: dancing lights at will; darkness and faerie fire each once per day. Faerie fire save DC 12. These spells require concentration; they do not stack with invisibility, suggestion, web, or spider climb.

traits.name: Wizard Spellcasting
traits.text: 4th-level caster; Intelligence, spell save DC 13, spell attack +5. Four 1st-level and three 2nd-level slots. One concentration spell at a time.

traits.name: Spider Staff
traits.text: Attuned; 10 charges. While held, use an action for spider climb (1 charge) or web (2 charges; DC 15); no components. Regains 1d6+4 charges at dusk. If the last charge is spent, roll d20; on 1 the staff crumbles. Weapon hits add 1d6 poison. Source: LMoP p. 53.

actions.name: Spider Staff
actions.note: Add 1d6 poison to the same hit. Weapon attack, not a spell.

actions.name: Staff · extra poison
actions.note: No saving throw is specified for this staff’s extra weapon damage.

actions.name: Ray of Frost
actions.note: On a hit, target speed reduced by 10 ft. until start of Nezznar’s next turn. Level-4 caster: one damage die. PHB 2014 p. 271.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp
actions.note: Advantage against metal armor; on hit target cannot take reactions until start of its next turn. PHB 2014 p. 275.

actions.name: Magic Missile · one dart
actions.note: Three darts using a 1st-level slot; four at 2nd level. Assign each dart before damage. Shield blocks them. PHB 2014 p. 257.

actions.name: Potion of Healing
actions.note: One potion; use the campaign’s 2014 action cost unless a table ruling overrides it. LMoP p. 53.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.text: Spend a 1st-level slot when hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile: +5 AC until start of next turn, including the triggering attack, and no magic missile damage. One reaction.

spells: Cantrips: mage hand, ray of frost, shocking grasp; innate dancing lights.
1st level (4 slots): mage armor, magic missile, shield.

2nd level (3 slots): invisibility (action; concentration up to 1 hour; ends when the target attacks or casts a spell), suggestion (action; DC 13 Wisdom; concentration up to 8 hours; a reasonable course of activity for a creature that hears and understands him; harmful demands fail).

Innate 1/day each: darkness (action; concentration up to 10 minutes) and faerie fire (action; DC 12 Dexterity; concentration up to 1 minute). Staff: spider climb (concentration up to 1 hour) and web (concentration up to 1 hour, DC 15 Dexterity to avoid restraint; action DC 15 Strength to break free).
data.name: Nezznar the Black Spider
data.variants: An alerted Nezznar casts invisibility and stays near the table; record the slot and concentration. He joins on the round after the spiders attack. He has no misty step or teleport ability. Escape needs a reachable route, movement and appropriate checks. He understands Elvish and Undercommon; establish how parley is understood. Creature facts are published; proposed choices and outcomes in the encounter plan are DM options.
